_meta.description: The campaign ledger: an empty but well-defined rollup table that performance numbers are entered into once, and only once, they exist in an authorized first-party report. Every cell stays blank until then - no conversion score, no revenue forecast, no modelled value, per the owner's 2026-11-17 directive and the site's standing no-inference rule.
_meta.authorized_sources_rule: A row is added only when its numbers come from an authorized first-party report: an Associates Central report export, or this site's own first-party analytics export (docs/tracker.js, local-only). Nothing observed anywhere else is eligible. Each row records the report it came from and the date it was entered, which is the provenance trail.
_meta.event_ledger: Raw events are appended to data/tracking.jsonl using the five defined event types implemented in engine/tracking.py; this file is the dated rollup of those events per campaign/channel. engine.tracking refuses synthetic events by design.
_meta.attribution_windows_source: The windows below are quoted from the official Commission Income Statement Section 1, re-read 2026-11-17 (data/verification-session-1f4a7a22.json rows POL-3, POL-4).
_meta.no_forecast_rule: Operating Agreement Section 4: Amazon makes no representation about the traffic or commission income an Associate can expect. This ledger therefore publishes no projection, benchmark or target - only observed, sourced rows.

columns.definition: When the row was entered, from the report's own period end.
The authorized first-party report the row was copied from (e.g. Associates Central reported commissions export, local tracker export).
How the traffic reached the site (e.g. organic search, RSS reader, direct, a specific referrer). Derived only from first-party analytics, never inferred.
Sessions eligible for attribution: a Session begins when a customer clicks through a Special Link and ends at the first of 24 hours, an order, or a click through another publisher's Special Link.
Clicks on this site's Special Links, as reported by Associates Central (which is the number that carries attribution), optionally cross-checked against the local tracker.
Ordered items attributed to this site's links: cart orders may complete up to 89 days after the click, and the product must ship and be paid for within 180 days of purchase.

five_events.definition: A tracked unit was shown to a visitor (client-side, first-party only). Recorded by the local tracker; carries no attribution on its own.
A visitor activated a Special Link on this site. Starts the attribution Session.
five_events.window: Session opens at the click and ends at the first of: 24 hours elapsing, an order being placed, or the customer clicking another publisher's Special Link.

five_events.definition: The attribution Session record opened by a click, as Amazon measures it.
five_events.window: 24 hours / order / competing Special Link, whichever comes first (Commission Income Statement 1(b)).

five_events.definition: A Qualifying Purchase attributed to a Special Link: 1-Click purchases during the Session, or cart orders completed no later than 89 days after the initial click.
five_events.window: During the Session, or up to 89 days for cart orders; the product must ship and be paid for within 180 days of purchase (Commission Income Statement 1(b)(iii)).

five_events.definition: A returned or refunded order, which reduces reported commission; recorded only when the Associates report states it.

provenance.entry: Raw event ledger defined (data/tracking.jsonl, engine/tracking.py): append-only JSONL, five event types, synthetic events refused; shipped with the 2026-11-16 sessions' work.
